mapping_json.fidelity_notes: GX-07. Section-B HoWA row: attribute-stacking -> flat DAMAGE is NOT an accrual to docket #8 (siege-ballista is stat->proxy-COUNT; HoWA is stat->DAMAGE -- distinct). Engine expresses added-flat-damage via trait/affix rolls but has NO lane for 'ALL damage is a linear function of stacked primary attributes' -- that stat->damage COUPLING is the identity; affix flat-damage rolls approximate the OUTPUT without the coupling. Own mint-candidate FILED (not merged into docket #8).
